summary: INTERIM results for investigation OT-26-S0177, the BP16 protease inhibitor genotoxicity battery for Belquorin Pharma. The bacterial phase is complete; its negative outcome is limited to the article-specific bacterial records, whose identity linkage is [TBC] here. HepG2 is a separate preliminary viability screen; the TK6 scoring exclusion and repeat are recorded separately, with repeat scoring still open.
